attack: The strongest opposing claim is CAD-up catch-up: BoC energy minutes plus 3% headline plus a shallow 1m CORRA +29bp by December mean Canada must re-rate, lifting CAD and/or CA 2Y, and that this should either crowd out long AU_2Y or be paired with it via CA-AU / AUDCAD. Policy path first: the 1m Dec 2.58 print is a four-contract coverage artifact, not a dovish-exception proof. 3m CORRA already prices +136.5bp by Sep-2028. Labor 38, employment -42k, core near 2%, and the Saudi workaround are the binding Canada facts; minutes flagged a risk, they did not hike. Spot CAD-up fails the rates-first gate: USDCAD-WTI and USDCAD-CA-US_2Y links are weak, AUDCAD's 1m impulse was CAD cheapening versus USD, and 99th-percentile unsigned AUD OI is squeeze risk not an AUD-up signal.

AUD-up does not survive the same path check. Rate-hawk's instrument is Dec SOFR, and that seat already discarded paying AONIA on housing transmission. AU 2Y at 4.999 sits through live Mar-2027 AONIA 4.86. Paying Australian duration or buying AUD is paying through a cash-futures path that already embeds +21.5bp by October and +51 to +59.5bp later, into activity 54 / consumer 48 / labor 50. Global-tightening extrapolation after a >90% priced Fed hike is the known information; the new binding information is the housing channel.

Do not amend into pay-CA, long CAD, or short AUDCAD. Those expressions require the catch-up assumption this remit rejects. Outright long AU_2Y keeps the AONIA discrepancy without importing Canada energy-pass-through risk or the crowded AUD-cross surface.
defense: FACT: AONIA 4.35 (17-Sep-2026); ASX 30D Oct 4.565 (+21.5bp, OI 21752, volume 4450), Nov 4.685 (+33.5bp), Dec 4.725 (+37.5bp), Mar-2027 4.86 (+51bp), mid-2027 peak 4.945 (+59.5bp), Feb-2028 still 4.84 (+49bp). Zero cuts versus overnight are priced through Feb-2028. Official RBA F1 OIS is 01-Dec-2022 vintage and unused. NSW stamp duty -24% y/y, volumes -18%, Sydney/Melbourne values more than 7% off peak; AU employment -15.8k, unemployment 4.5%, Westpac-MI 84.4 (-5.2%). AU 2Y 4.999 as of 16 Sep is 99.01st percentile 1y; that percentile is discovery context, not the thesis. INFERENCE: restrictive policy is already biting through housing faster than the priced hike path admits. The next Australian front-end impulse is lower-rate repricing, not delivery of +21.5bp by October. Receiving AU 2Y owns that path discrepancy. Spot short AUDUSD remains the inferior alternative because CFTC AUD OI is 99.0th percentile 1y with null nets. UNKNOWN: executable broker marks, RBA meeting probabilities, CFTC trader-class direction, and whether 3.6% trimmed-mean plus the energy shock keep the RBA hiking into the slump. The 2025-12-22 analog after a similar +39bp 1m AU 2Y sell-off continued +8.8bp 1m / +54.7bp 3m and remains the main historical threat.

CAD-up catch-up, if it prints, is a Canada-path event. It does not make AONIA fairly priced. Global term-premium spill from energy or a still-rising SOFR path is already a listed principal risk on long AU_2Y, not a reason to switch into CAD. Carry opposes receiving a high AU front end, but the 5% ACT/365 vig is charged while flat and the edge is path-repricing, not carry.

What would concede: ASX AONIA-implied rates keep climbing along the priced +51bp (Mar-2027) to +59.5bp (mid-2027) path without offsetting housing/labour deterioration, or AU trimmed-mean CPI re-accelerates from the July 3.6% y/y print. A delivered BoC hike that also lifts AONIA would be a correlated risk, not proof the original Australian housing-versus-path discrepancy was wrong. Trade unchanged: long AU_2Y, entry/target/stop remain JSON null because the packet has no executable mark.
holes_in_opposing_case: FACT: MX 1m CORRA has only four contracts and labels Dec-26 2.58 (+29bp versus CORRA 2.29) as the available-strip terminal. INFERENCE: CAD-up catch-up (perma-bull short CA_2Y, catalyst-junkie short COAZ26, value-guy long CA-US_2Y, cross-merchant short AUDCAD, positioning-cynic pay-CA versus receive-AU) treats that four-contract artifact as if Canada prices almost no hiking cycle. The same frozen path set already shows 3m CORRA grinding to 3.655 by Sep-2028 (+136.5bp). Rate-hawk's own policy-path check rejects 1m +29bp as the headline underpricing for that reason. Paying Canada or buying CAD is paying a longer strip that already has a full re-hiking grind against labor 38, employment -42k, wages +2.0% y/y, CPI-trim 1.9%/median 2.0%, and consumer 45. UNKNOWN: MX CORRA OI/volume are null, so the 1m strip cannot even be shown as an uncrowded catch-up vehicle.

FACT: BoC minutes flag higher energy pass-through; they did not deliver a hike. Canada August CPI held at 3% with core near 2%. Saudi Oman STS workaround reduced the extreme oil-supply tail. Packet USDCAD versus WTI r-squared 0.017 and USDCAD versus CA-US_2Y r-squared 0.022, both weak. INFERENCE: energy/ToT CAD-up is not a policy-path mechanism. A minutes risk-flag plus a two-sided oil tail is not a reason to abandon AONIA-overpriced-hike. Catalyst-junkie lists core-near-2% and labor 38 as invalidation of the same COAZ26 pay they are selling as dated transmission.

FACT: CA 2Y 3.27 already sits about 98bp over CORRA 2.29 and about 69bp over Dec 1m 2.58. Closest same-regime analog 2026-04-01 after a similar +31bp 1m CA 2Y backup then forwarded +12bp 1m / -6bp 3m. INFERENCE: the sovereign front end has already done more hawkish work than the 1m strip; 'strip lagging 2Y' can equally mean 2Y overshot, not that more hikes must print. 2022-06 and 2023-04 continuation analogs were first-cycle hiking with hotter labor/inflation, not a re-hike from CORRA 2.29 with core at target.

FACT: value-guy's own decomposition shows US 2Y minus SOFR about 91bp and CA 2Y minus CORRA about 98bp, so local term premia are similar and the -140bp CA-US 2Y gap is the overnight 156bp policy-level gap. INFERENCE: that is a two-speed cycle consistent with US labor 75 / inflation 72 versus CA labor 38 / inflation 55, not a dislocation that uniquely requires CAD-up. Receiving US 2Y at 4.76 (99.8th 1y) while SOFR still prices +75.25bp to Aug-2028 is not proof the US leg is finished, and it does not reprice AONIA.

FACT: positioning-cynic receive-AU / pay-CA and cross-merchant short AUDCAD both need the CAD-up catch-up I am attacking. CA-AU 2Y is only 51st percentile 1y at -164.9bp. AUDCAD 1m +1.95% was mostly USDCAD +1.74%, not AUDUSD +0.20%. INFERENCE: the 99.8th-percentile cross is USD-bid / CAD-weak residue (USDCHF 99.8th 1y), not a newly extreme AU-CA policy gap. AONIA 4.35 versus CORRA 2.29 is about 206bp of positive carry against short AUDCAD. If CA labor/core keep BoC on hold, CA-AU 2Y only works through AU yields falling, which is outright long AU_2Y without the pay-CA. UNKNOWN: CFTC AUD and CAD nets are null.

FACT: rate-hawk is the routed AUD-up seat, but the actual trade is pay SR1Z26, and that seat's policy-path check explicitly rejects paying AU cash futures because NSW stamp duty -24% y/y, volumes -18%, and Sydney/Melbourne values more than 7% off peak show the tightening channel already biting, with Dec AONIA volume 2. AUDUSD is 76.4th percentile 1y, +0.20% 1m, -0.73% 5d. INFERENCE: AUD_UP is a leftover tag from a US-hawk SOFR view, not a packet-supported AUD-bull case. Perma-bull, trend-follower and dollar-king also refuse long AUD as the expression while still tagging AU rates higher. AONIA already prices more near-term hikes than SOFR or 1m CORRA (Oct +21.5bp versus +6bp versus +1.5bp). AUD-up as hike premium is already in the cash path; the discrepancy is that this path is overpriced given housing.

FACT: catalyst-junkie rejects receive-AONIA because October already implies 4.565 versus 4.35, calling the housing catalyst 'not unpriced.' INFERENCE: priced is not delivered. The 16 Sep housing print is in the packet while Oct still trades +21.5bp with OI 21752 and volume 4450. The dove test is whether that hike is realized into a pandemic-sized stamp-duty hole, not whether the contract already prints it. Carry-is-king and dollar-king CAD_DOWN views actually confirm CAD-up is not uniquely implied; their receive-US / long-USDCAD expressions are a US-path debate and do not make AONIA's zero-cut, +51 to +59.5bp path a fair Australian price.
